finding.migration_rule: V3 Runtime HTTP/IPC contract is new design work constrained by proven semantics; it must not be presented as a legacy HTTP compatibility surface.

options.--once: run one scheduler iteration and exit
options.--self-check: emit JSON self-check and exit 0 on ok or 2 on failure
options.--health-json: emit current runtime state JSON; if absent emit format + not_started
options.--max-seconds=N: bound runtime duration to non-negative integer seconds

windows_service_host.restart_rule: restart child when missing/exited unless service is stopping
windows_service_host.stop_rule: stop process tree; failure to stop is fatal for repair continuation

v3_ownership_correction.worker_registry_note: Historical process launching is evidence of supervision cadence only; each business worker/domain remains owned by Local or its explicit V3 component.
v3_ownership_correction.print_note: Historical printing entry in the Runtime registry does not transfer Print Agent ownership to Runtime in V3.
v3_ownership_correction.retirement_note: center_projection is historical evidence only; SOKNA Center/Core was cancelled before operational baseline and must not be implemented or configured in V3.

next_contract_work: choose versioned local transport only after consumer requirements are audited
define machine-bound authentication and secret rotation
define health/diagnostic schema by adapting proven state-file semantics
define supervision commands without exposing business mutations
add compatibility vectors for service lifecycle and health semantics
